minutes.headline: Committee approved before/after-school care options and the secretaries' contract, and signed the superintendent's evaluation.
minutes.summary: After an executive session on non-union negotiations, the committee heard the superintendent's report and acted on a music trip, school handbooks, extended-day drop-off and late pickup options with a bus release waiver, a secretaries' contract and sick bank waiver, a donation, and lunch prices. It also reviewed the superintendent's evaluation and the primary school plan review, then set the August meeting and planned to invite other boards in October.

what_happened.line: The School Committee approved the before- and after-school care options, including a bus release waiver, after discussing early drop-off and late pickup.
The committee accepted the secretaries' contract ratification and a sick bank waiver; the minutes describe a three-year agreement.
The committee authorized the chair to sign the superintendent's evaluation, which is to be corrected and posted on the district website.
The committee approved a lunch price increase, described as state-mandated after an audit, and accepted a music boosters donation.
The committee approved school handbooks and the first presentation of a high school music trip; the next meeting was set for August 14 and a joint meeting for October 16.

why_it_matters: Families who use before- or after-school care, or who buy school lunches, will see new fees and prices, and the secretaries' contract sets a multi-year personnel cost in the school budget.
The joint meeting planned with the Select Board and Finance Committee is the setting where school and town budget questions may be raised together.
